class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/HeartbeatPublisherPlugin
class.description: A simple plugin that publishes a heartbeat message every second to demonstrate the plugin system.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/CameraPlugin
class.description: Provides RGB-D camera support the MuJoCo simulation by wrapping existing cameras in the MJCF with republishers for camera info, color, and depth images.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/ExternalWrenchPlugin
class.description: Plugin that applies an external wrench (force + torque) to a named MuJoCo body.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/FreeJointStatePublisherPlugin
class.description: Publishes the pose and velocity of every MuJoCo free-joint body to a single topic.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/FtsGravCompPlugin
class.description: Runs gravity compensation on the wrench found by the force torque sensor as specified in the params file.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/Mujoco3dLidarPlugin
class.description: Plugin that republishes mujoco lidar sensor data as ROS messages.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/BaseVelocityPlugin
class.description: Drives a mobile/floating-base robot from a commanded planar body velocity.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/RangefinderLidarPlugin
class.description: [Deprecated] Wraps MuJoCo rangefinder sensors as ROS 2 LaserScan publishers.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/WeldPlugin
class.description: Toggles a MuJoCo weld equality constraint between the robot wrist and a package body to simulate a grasp. Subscribes to /gripper_command (std_msgs/Bool) and /active_package_index (std_msgs/Int32).
